links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified AAOS OrthoInfo pediatric orthopaedic patient education materials
links.outcome: Readability of patient education materials (grade level, Flesch Reading Ease, Fernández Huerta), with clinical accuracy reviewed on 10 English PEMs
links.effect: English mean grade level 9.8 to 5.8 (P < .001); Flesch Reading Ease 56.9 to 76.4 (P < .001). Spanish Fernández Huerta 81.0 to 100.7 (P < .001), grade level from fifth-sixth to fourth. All 10 reviewed English PEMs judged clinically accurate.
links.quote: The AI models significantly improved readability across all measures.

design_hint: reading-level constraint with clinician accuracy review
